C0172.title: Measuring and disrupting anti-adblockers using differential execution analysis
C0172.summary: This study employs differential execution analysis to automatically detect anti-adblocker mechanisms, finding that 30.5% of Alexa top 10,000 websites deploy such measures, with over 90% showing no visible warning. It also develops JavaScript rewriting and API hooking schemes to help ad blockers evade anti-adblock detection.
